summary: Tested new mediator-facilitated safety joint reports (backend + frontend). Backend safety enforcement, full cycle with mediator, privacy, and joint_public shape all work as specified. Added new pytest module tests/test_safety_reports.py (10 tests) covering mediator gating (400/404/200), mixed vs all-safety subject sets, full cycle w/ mediator viewing completed report + PDF, privacy against B and mediator, and non-safety regression. Also fixed the existing all-safety multi test in test_hub_features.py to supply a mediator email. Full suite: 77/77 passed. Frontend UI verified for Hub red safety cluster (bg-red-700), JointNew safety-pathway-note + mediator-email-input on invite step (red-50/red-200), Send Invitation gating (disabled without mediator email; toast 'No professional account found' for unregistered mediator), and JointAssessment safety-confidentiality box (red, includes mediator name 'Laura Mediator'). Found 3 frontend gaps vs the spec: (1) JointReport.jsx has no jr-safety-notice banner nor red title when is_safety, (2) Wizard.jsx IPV card has no red border styling, (3) components/report/Pages.jsx IPV report-title is not red conditionally.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing red title styling AND missing jr-safety-notice red confidentiality banner for is_safety reports. Current title is always text-brand-purple; no jr-safety-notice element exists in the file.
IPV wizard card (type-option-ipv) does not have red border styling. All type cards share the same className with border-border/hover:border-primary — no is_safety/IPV-specific red border applied.
IPV 10-page report title uses text-primary regardless of assessment type. No conditional red styling for IPV report title.

action_items: In JointReport.jsx, render title in red (e.g., text-red-700) and add a red confidentiality banner with data-testid="jr-safety-notice" containing SAFETY confidentiality text when report.is_safety is true.
In Wizard.jsx, apply red border (border-red-500 or similar) to the IPV type option card so type-option-ipv visually stands out.
In components/report/Pages.jsx Page1, when the report is IPV (or is_safety), style report-title in red.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: mediator lookup uses body.mediator_email.lower() — good; but does not verify mediator is different from the parent (a parent could enter their own email if role is professional). Consider blocking self-mediation.
joint_engine.py: SAFETY_PURPOSE hard-checked via 'startswith' — safe, but consider unifying purpose selection through a single source of truth.

JointNew.jsx submit disabled logic: `(isSafety && !isPro && !mediatorEmail.trim())` — good gate; but there is no client-side email format validation before hitting the API for mediator; server returns 404 which is fine, but a client-side format hint would be nicer UX.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_hub_features.py (updated test_safety_pathway_multi_creates to supply mediator_email — the previous test was incompatible with the new safety enforcement)

success_rate.frontend: 70% (hub + JointNew safety pathway + JointAssessment confidentiality box verified; JointReport red banner/title, Wizard IPV red border, and IPV report red title are missing implementations)

test_credentials: Admin mattsossi@bsossi.com / CoParents2026!. Fresh test parents + professional accounts registered via /api/auth/register per test.

Frontend gaps remain in JointReport.jsx (needs data-testid=jr-safety-notice + red title on is_safety), Wizard.jsx (IPV card red border), and components/report/Pages.jsx (IPV report-title red). After main agent adds these, verify by (a) completing both parents on a safety joint report and opening /joint/{id}/report to see red title + jr-safety-notice banner, (b) /wizard type step showing red IPV card, (c) generating an IPV completed report and verifying report-title is red. Backend tests to keep green: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q — currently 77/77.
rca of the issue: The three frontend gaps are simply un-implemented conditional styling: JointReport.jsx never reads report.is_safety, Wizard.jsx type card class is uniform for all keys, and Pages.jsx Page1 uses text-primary unconditionally. Main agent needs to add is_safety-conditional Tailwind classes and a jr-safety-notice element.
